split_policy: v1 questions keep their frozen splits. Each new question was assigned at creation, before any run: positions 2 and 4 of every five, in file order, are heldout.

types.fact: a specific statement in one text
types.concept: a doctrine or idea, phrased in the asker's words
types.comparison: two thinkers on one topic; both thinkers' gold spans are needed
types.objection: an objection or opponent's view and its reply
types.followup: an elliptical question after a prior turn; 'standalone' is a reference rewrite
types.out_of_corpus: not answerable from the library; the expected answer is a refusal
